implementation.targetScope: diffWords and diffWordsWithSpace, case folding, word Intl.Segmenter, oneChangePerToken, bounded edits and cooperative callback execution. No patch, character, line, array, CSS, JSON or sentence diff APIs.

changes: No upstream runtime ships; token spans and an independent edit frontier preserve source text.
Disjoint large inputs avoid exploring every edit distance.
Invalid bounds reject explicitly; timeout zero permits unchanged matches but no changed search.
Current diff9 punctuation and soft-hyphen tokenization replaces app8 behavior.

caller.scope: InlineDiff renders proposed problem wording using diffWords, added/removed/value fields and React text children. No application adoption claimed.
